# DevOS
> AI-powered development platform with autonomous AI agents for planning, coding, testing, and deployment.

## What it does
DevOS provides a team of AI agents that work through complete software development cycles. Four built-in agents (Planner, Developer, QA, DevOps) handle everything from architecture planning to production deployment, with built-in collaboration tools and observability.

## Key Features
- 4 built-in AI agents: Planner, Developer, QA, DevOps
- Custom agent builder and marketplace
- Live code streaming
- Three-tier memory system for context persistence
- Multi-model routing (use different LLMs for different tasks)
- GitHub integration with Kanban boards
- One-click deployment (Railway, custom domains, databases)
- Enterprise security (BYOK encryption, SSO/SAML, RBAC)
- Full observability (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Jaeger)

## Use Cases
- Solo developers wanting an AI development team
- Startups accelerating development velocity
- Agencies building client projects faster
- Enterprise teams augmenting existing workflows

## Status
- Currently in early access / waitlist phase

## Competitors
- GitHub Copilot Workspace, Cursor, Replit Agent, Devin
